final: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT il.InvoiceId AS invoice_id, c.Country AS country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_price) AS value FROM invoice_averages), differences AS (SELECT ia.invoice_id, ia.country, ia.average_price, ia.average_price - oa.value AS difference FROM invoice_averages AS ia CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oa.value IS NOT NULL), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(difference) AS value FROM differences GROUP BY country), ranked AS (SELECT d.invoice_id, d.country, d.average_price, d.difference, d.difference - ca.value AS adjusted_difference, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (d.difference - ca.value) IS NULL, d.difference - ca.value DESC) AS position FROM differences AS d JOIN country_averages AS ca ON d.country COLLATE BINARY = ca.country) SELECT invoice_id, country, average_price, difference, adjusted_difference FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY adjusted_difference DESC
